name: English
confirm_clear_finished: Permanently delete all photos of finished tasks? This can't be undone.
title: Title
est_no_seconds: Seconds aren't kept, so the {n} after {u} is left out. For hours write h, e.g. {h}.
default_due_time: Default due time (when a date is picked)
tag_hint: Type a name and press Enter. Click a tag to rename it, × to remove it, drag to reorder.
title_format_hint: Which parts a task's title shows, in this order. Drag to reorder.
file_intro: Your settings are saved in this file on your computer. You can open it, keep a copy, or load a settings file to use its presets.
file_upload_help: Only the options in the file change; anything it leaves out keeps its current value.
sc_hint: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Escape cancels. In Other information, plain Enter always starts a new line.
done_undo_hint: Moves to Completed in 7 seconds. Click again to cancel.
err_invalid_shortcuts: Each shortcut needs its own keys.
err_invalid_email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
err_invalid_estimate: Can't read that time. Try 90min, 1h30min, 1.5h or 2d.
err_invalid_price: Enter a valid price (0 or more).
err_invalid_list: A list needs text items of up to 40 characters each (50 items at most).
err_invalid_title_order: The title format must include the title and use each part only once.
err_invalid_settings_file: That doesn't look like a PupQueue settings file.
err_file_too_big: That file is too large to be a settings file.
err_unsupported_image: Only image files can be uploaded (png, jpg, gif, webp, ...).
completed_limit_hint: How many of the latest finished tasks the Board shows under Completed.
err_invalid_icon: That icon can't be used. Try a small png or jpg.
start_help: New tasks go to Ready or Waitlist by priority. By default, Critical, High and Medium tasks are ready right away and Low or Lowest tasks start in the waitlist. Pick Waitlist or Ready here to choose by hand.
ready_priorities_hint: Ticked priorities start in Ready, the others in Waitlist. You can still choose by hand when you create a task.
paid_ready_hint: When a task is paid, it goes to Ready instead of Waitlist, whatever its priority. This also moves a Waitlist task when you mark it paid. Choosing Waitlist by hand, or snoozing, still keeps it there.
start_help_paid: Paid tasks go to Ready too (Settings > New tasks).
err_invalid_paid_ready: That setting must be on or off.
animations_hint: Turn off to stop all movement on the page, like lists unfolding and highlights. The Mark done countdown bar still runs so you can see the time left.
err_invalid_animations: That setting must be on or off.
kind_info_project: {projects} are the biggest items and hold {tasks}. When one of its {tasks} moves to Ready or WIP, the {project} moves there too.
kind_info_task: {tasks} can belong to one of your {projects} and hold {todos}, which you tick off on the card. When one of its {todos} moves to Ready or WIP, the {task} and its {project} move there too. Finishing {todos} never finishes the {task}.
kind_info_todo: {todos} are the children of {tasks}, a plain checklist. Click one to mark it done, hold it (or press X) to cross it out, and click again to undo. Finished ones leave the card but stay under Children in the {task}'s details. They are hidden on the board unless you turn them on in Settings > Projects.
del_children_q: This {x} has {n} children. What should happen to them?
dont_ask: Don't ask again (you can change this in Settings > Projects)
confirm_delete_keep: Delete this {x}? Its {n} children are kept.
agile_hint: Projects, tasks and todos are called initiatives, epics and stories, like in Jira.
todos_on_board_hint: Off: {todos} only show on the card of their {task}.
delete_children: Deleting an item that has children
err_invalid_parent: That parent can't hold this item.
drop_bad_project: {projects} stay at the top: they can't go inside another item.
drop_bad_task: A {task} can only go inside a {project}.
drop_bad_todo: A {todo} can only go inside a {task}.
drop_bad_priority: Sorted by priority: an item can only move among items with the same priority. To drag freely, pick “By hand” in Settings > Projects.
drop_bad_due: Sorted by priority and due date: an item can only move among items with the same priority and due date. To drag freely, choose another order in Settings > Projects.
project_order_priority: By priority, then your dragged order
project_order_hint: Drag a row between two others (or press Alt+↑/↓ on it) to move it, or onto a {project} or {task} to put it inside. Finished items always stay at the bottom.
err_invalid_bool: That setting must be on or off.
kind_colors_hint: The round icon before each title shows whether it is a {project}, {task} or {todo}. Pick a colour for each.
emoji_on: Show a custom emoji button before titles
emoji_hint: Off by default. When on, every project, task and todo gets a small emoji button before its title: click it to pick an emoji or type your own. Turning it off hides the emojis but keeps them.
kid_hint: Click to open · Drag or Alt+↑/↓: move
todo_hint: Click: done · Hold or press X: cross out · Click again: undo · Drag or Alt+↑/↓: move
todo_done_last_on: Move done and crossed-out {todos} to the bottom
todo_done_last_hint: Off: they stay where they are. Drag a {todo} (or press Alt+↑/↓ on it) to change the order by hand.
err_forbidden: Only PupQueue's own page can change your data.
err_file_locked: Couldn't save: a file in task_records is open in another program (like Excel). Close it and try again; nothing was changed.
